alert_command_failed: A request to your child's phone failed
alert_empty:
No updates yet.
Pick a school or academy on the Places tab
and arrivals will show up here.
alert_header_subtitle: Arrivals, battery and connection, in order of time.
alert_low_battery: Your child's phone is low on battery
alert_no_family: Could not find your family. Please close the app and open it again.
alert_notification_denied: Notifications are turned off, so this cannot be enabled. Go to phone Settings → Apps → KidCare → Notifications and turn them on.
alert_permission_off: A permission was turned off on your child's phone
alert_service_hint: Turn this on and updates reach you even when the app is closed. In exchange, a small notification stays in your status bar and it uses a little more battery. Left off, you only see updates when you open the app.
alert_service_notification_text: On, so updates reach you right away. You can turn it off on the Updates tab.
alert_signal_lost: Your child's phone has not answered for a while
child_family_gone:
Your location is not being shared right now.
Ask a parent for a new code and connect again.
child_home_title: You are connected to your parents
child_home_title_gone: You are no longer connected to your parents
child_permission_missing:
%1$s is turned off.
Turn it on so your location can be shared.
child_play_services_fixable:
Google Play services is missing or too old, so location cannot be sent.
Tap the button below to fix it. (Messages and sound changes still work.)
child_play_services_unfixable:
This phone has no Google Play services, so location cannot be sent.
Show this screen to your parents. (Messages and sound changes still work.)
child_sharing_on:
Your parents can see where you are right now.
So they can find you quickly if you get lost.
control_alarm_hint_detail: It rings once on your child's phone at the time you pick. If that time has already passed, it rings at the same time the next day — your child's clock decides whether that is today or tomorrow. While an alarm is set, a clock icon shows in your child's status bar, and it stops on its own after 5 minutes.
control_alarm_set: Set an alarm for this time
control_alarm_state_confirmed: An alarm is set for %1$s on your child's phone
control_alarm_state_pending: Sent the %1$s alarm · waiting for your child's phone to answer
control_command_queued: Not sent yet. It will reach your child's phone and run once the internet connects — things may have changed by then.
control_command_timeout: Your child's phone is not answering
control_command_timeout_format:
Your child's phone is not answering
%1$s
control_error_alarm_exact_denied: The alarm could not be set because 'Alarms & reminders' is turned off on your child's phone. Go to Settings → Apps → KidCare → Alarms & reminders on that phone and turn it on.
control_error_child_failed: Your child's phone could not carry out this request.
control_error_message_notification_off: The message could not be shown because notifications are off on your child's phone. Go to Settings → Apps → KidCare → Notifications on that phone and turn them on.
control_error_ringer_denied: The sound setting permission is off on your child's phone. It has to be turned on there before this can change.
control_find_hint: It rings loudly even in silent mode. It stops on its own after 5 minutes.
control_find_stop_hint: Stop the sound if it is already ringing
control_header_subtitle: Send sounds, messages and alarms straight to your child's phone.
control_last_seen_skewed_value: %1$s (based on your child's clock, so not exact)
control_lock_hint: If your child changes the sound, it goes back to what you chose a few seconds later.
control_lock_switch: Change it back if my child undoes it
control_message_hint_detail: It shows up large on your child's screen. It makes no sound, just one vibration. When your child taps 'Got it', this changes to 'Read'.
control_message_unread: Delivered to your child's phone · not read yet
control_network_readonly: Android does not let another app switch these on or off. We can only show you the state.
control_ringer_dnd_note: While Do Not Disturb is on, Android reports silent even if the ringer is set to ring. That is why the sound state above may not be exact.
control_ringer_status_loading: Checking the sound mode on your child's phone
control_ringer_status_unknown: The last sound mode has not been checked yet
error_generic_format:
Something went wrong with the connection
%1$s
error_server_setup: The server setup is not finished yet. Tell whoever installed the app for you.
error_unauthenticated: You were signed out. Please close the app and open it again.
event_detail_permission: %1$s — please turn it back on on your child's phone
find_phone_notification_title: A parent is looking for this phone
find_phone_title: A parent is looking for this phone
guardian_disconnect_banner:
Your child's phone has not answered the request sent %1$s
Open the KidCare app once on your child's phone and it will connect again.
guardian_start_join_family: Join an existing family with a code
guardian_start_title: How would you like to start?
map_battery_info_message: The level shown here is what your child's phone reported. Android does not allow reading which app used how much battery from another phone, so that has to be checked in Settings > Battery on your child's phone.
map_live_cancel_description: Live location connecting. Tap to cancel
map_live_start_description: Live location off. Tap to turn on
map_live_stop_description: Live location on. Tap to turn off
map_live_stopped: Live view has ended. The last location received is still on the map.
map_live_timeout: Live view ended after the 10 minute safety limit.
map_live_waiting: Finding the live location. Please wait until the GPS signal comes through.
map_locate_no_fix: Your child's phone has not found its location yet. Please try again in a moment.
map_no_child: No child's phone is connected yet.
map_status_never: The location has never been checked. Tap 'Check location now'.
pairing_child_title:
Enter the 6-digit code
shown on your parent's phone
pairing_expired: The code has expired. Get a new one from your parent's phone.
pairing_guardian_hint:
On your child's phone, open the app,
choose 'Child' and enter this code to connect.
pairing_guardian_invite_guardian_hint:
On the other parent's phone, open the app,
choose 'Parent' → 'Join with a code' and enter this code.
pairing_guardian_invite_guardian_title: Enter this code on the other parent's phone
pairing_guardian_join_title:
Enter the 6-digit code
you got from a parent in the family
pairing_guardian_title: Enter this code on your child's phone
pairing_not_found: There is no such code. Please check it again.
pairing_offline: Cannot reach the internet. Please check your Wi-Fi or mobile data.
pairing_wrong_role: This code is not for the role you chose. Check which code is for the child and which is for a parent.
perm_activity_reason: Knowing whether your child is walking or still lets the app check the location less often while still, which saves battery.
perm_background_reason: To send the location while the app is closed, this has to be 'Allow all the time'. Choose 'Allow all the time' on the settings screen.
perm_battery_hint: When the settings screen opens, find KidCare in the list and change it to 'Unrestricted'.
perm_battery_reason: Without this, the phone puts the app to sleep and the location stops. Choose 'Allow' on the settings screen.
perm_denied_permanently: It was just denied, so this screen cannot ask again. Tap 'Turn on in Settings' to open the app settings and turn the permission on there.
perm_dnd_reason: This lets a parent change the sound and vibration. Find KidCare in the list and turn it on.
perm_location_reason: Needed so your parents know where you are right now.
perm_notification_reason: Needed to receive messages from your parents and to show that the location is being shared.
perm_title: Just a few things to turn on
place_delete_message:
%1$s

Once deleted, arriving or leaving here will no longer send an alert.
place_editor_map_hint: Move the map so the cross in the middle sits on this place. The blue circle is where the alert goes off.
place_editor_name_required: Please write a name. This is the name that shows in the alert, as in 'Arrived at ○○'.
place_editor_no_child_location: Your child's location is not known yet, so the map opened wide. Please move it by hand to find the place.
place_editor_notify_none_hint: With both off, this place sends no alerts. The place itself stays.
place_empty:
No places yet.
Tap 'Add a place' below
and pick somewhere like 'School' or 'Academy'.
We will tell you when your child arrives or leaves.
place_header_subtitle: Save a school or academy and we will tell you about arrivals and departures.
place_limit_notice: You can save up to %1$d places. To add a new one, delete a place you no longer use.
place_no_family: Could not find your family. Please close the app and open it again.
place_save_slow: The save was sent but the server has not confirmed it yet. It saves on its own once the internet connects.
place_sync_failed_format:
The place was saved but your child's phone could not be told. Open this screen again and we will try once more.
%1$s
place_sync_no_child: The place is saved. It applies on its own once your child's phone connects.
place_sync_pending: Not delivered to your child's phone yet. It is still using the old places.
place_sync_slow: The place is saved. Telling your child's phone finishes once the internet connects.
role_subtitle:
You can choose again before connecting.
Once connected, it cannot be changed.
schedule_allday_message:
The start and the end are both %1$s.
Saved like this, the chosen days switch to %2$s for the whole 24 hours.
schedule_default_cleared: When a rule ends, the sound is left as it is.
schedule_default_hint: When a rule ends, your child's phone comes back to this.
schedule_default_saved: When a rule ends, it goes back to %1$s.
schedule_delete_message:
%1$s

Once deleted, the sound will not change on its own during this time.
schedule_editor_days_required: Please pick at least one day. With no day chosen, this rule never runs.
schedule_empty:
No times set yet.
Tap 'Add a rule' below
and try something like 'Silent on weekday nights'.
schedule_header_subtitle: Switches between ring, vibrate and silent by day and time.
schedule_holiday_cleared: Rules run on public holidays too.
schedule_holiday_subtitle: On days off, none of the rules below run.
schedule_holiday_unknown: This phone could not work out the holiday dates. Even with the switch on, only the days of the week are used.
schedule_no_family: Could not find your family. Please close the app and open it again.
schedule_overlap_message:
This time overlaps the '%1$s' rule.
While they overlap, the rule made later wins.
schedule_overlap_message_more:
This time overlaps '%1$s' and %2$d more rules.
While they overlap, the rule made later wins.
schedule_save_slow: The save was sent but the server has not confirmed it yet. It saves on its own once the internet connects.
schedule_sync_failed_format:
The rule was saved but your child's phone could not be told. Open this screen again and we will try once more.
%1$s
schedule_sync_no_child: The rule is saved. It applies on its own once your child's phone connects.
schedule_sync_pending: Not delivered to your child's phone yet. It is still running the old rules.
schedule_sync_slow: The rule is saved. Telling your child's phone finishes once the internet connects.
timeline_drag_handle: Drag up or down to resize the trip log
tracking_notification_text: Letting your parents know where you are
